## My account

Sign in or create account

Boston Scientific accounts are for healthcare professionals only.

Create an account to access online training and education on EDUCARE, manage your customer profile,
and connect with customer support and service teams.

My Boston Scientific account

Access your online applications and manage your customer profile.

[Manage my Boston Scientific account][147]

## Featured stories

[heart arteries showing implantation of Boston Scientific stunt.]

Patients and innovation

### **3 cutting-edge cancer therapies**

These treatments destroy tumors, lessen side effects and reduce pain.

[Learn how they work][158]
[Boston Scientific employees signs a Boston Scientific quality wall.]

Corporate responsibility

### How we ensure product and patient safety

At Boston Scientific, every employee plays a role in transforming lives.

[See how we create a culture of quality][159]
[Two smiling woman and a man looking toward camera while holding certificate.]

Team and culture

### **Helping our employees grow**

Our award-winning career development program teaches skills for work – and life.

[Meet two graduates][160]
[q1 26 earnings thumbnail.]

Company news

### **Interested in our latest financial results?**

Learn about our first-quarter performance.

[View the results here][161]

### We advance science for life

At Boston Scientific, we are driven to help patients experience more – more dancing, more playing,
more celebrating, more living.

## Explore Boston Scientific

[Smiling Boston Scientific employees at conference table.]

Careers

### Grow your career at Boston Scientific

Come help us transform lives by working at the forefront of medical innovation.

[Search for jobs][162]
[Boston Scientific CEO Mike Mahoney smiling in front of Boston Scientific sign.]

Investor Relations

### Information for investors and shareholders

Check our quarterly earnings reports, find out about upcoming presentations and more.

[View our financial performance][163]
[Young girl in Boston scientific community tshirt and holding plant in her hand.]

Corporate Responsibility

### Acting on our mission to improve the health of patients around the world

We are advancing science for more innovative care, empowered people and a healthier planet.

[Explore our latest impact reporting][164]

Boston Scientific is dedicated to transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that
improve the health of patients around the world.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.
[ Cardiovascular ][173]
[ Orthopaedics ][174]
[ Surgery ][175]
[ Vision ][176]

### [What is wAIHA?][211]

Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (wAIHA) causes fatigue so profound, it can limit the lives of
people who have the condition. Learn more about this rare disease and a potential targeted treatment
developed by Johnson & Johnson that’s currently in clinical trials.

pressure waves has made the treatment of certain types of cardiovascular disease easier for doctors

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.
[ Cardiovascular ][173]
[ Orthopaedics ][174]
[ Surgery ][175]
[ Vision ][176]

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

## About the journal

AsiaIntervention is the official journal of the Asian-Pacific Society of Interventional Cardiology
([APSIC][18]) and the Interventional Cardiology Foundation of India (ICFI).
It is an international, English language, peer-reviewed journal whose aim is to create a forum of
high quality research and education in the field of percutaneous and surgical cardiovascular
interventions.
It is released in an online format three times a year and twice in print.
AsiaIntervention has applied for indexation in Science Citation Index® (ISI), SciVerse Scopus,
MEDLINE®/PubMed®.

denervation for isolated post-capillary pulmonary hypertension; and excimer laser coronary
atherectomy for complex PCI; this issue’s Flashlights review a jailed DCB technique for
bifurcations; 3D OCT-guided single-string culotte bifurcation stenting; a surprising discovery in
LAD ISR; double-balloon tricuspid valvotomy; real-time IVUS-guided wiring in SCAD; and more…

## About the journal

AsiaIntervention is the official journal of the Asian-Pacific Society of Interventional Cardiology
([APSIC][18]) and the Interventional Cardiology Foundation of India (ICFI).
It is an international, English language, peer-reviewed journal whose aim is to create a forum of
high quality research and education in the field of percutaneous and surgical cardiovascular
interventions.
It is released in an online format three times a year and twice in print.
AsiaIntervention has applied for indexation in Science Citation Index® (ISI), SciVerse Scopus,
MEDLINE®/PubMed®.
[[Subscribe newsletter]][19]

## Volume 12, Number 1, March 2026

[[AsiaIntervention - New Issue March 2026]][20]

This issue of AsiaIntervention opens with original research on the use of sirolimus vs paclitaxel in
DCBs; continues with the PICCOLETO VI study; and includes original research on pulmonary artery
denervation for isolated post-capillary pulmonary hypertension; and excimer laser coronary
atherectomy for complex PCI; this issue’s Flashlights review a jailed DCB technique for
bifurcations; 3D OCT-guided single-string culotte bifurcation stenting; a surprising discovery in
LAD ISR; double-balloon tricuspid valvotomy; real-time IVUS-guided wiring in SCAD; and more…

# Some of our success** stories**

At Aurses Healthcare, we take pride in the many happy, healthy patients we’ve helped. Here’s what
our patients had to say about their experience with the Aurses Healthcare Clinic.

I have had aching veins for quite a few years but like so many people I just left them.
The whole experience was much better than I expected. The procedure itself didn’t hurt at all. Dr.
Taheri was very approachable, confidence and down to earth, which I find is unusual in doctors in my
experience. He was utterly professional and I felt I was being treated with the most up to date
techniques. [Read more][43]

At first, I didn’t know what to expect but doctor Hamed Taheri and all the nurses were absolutely
amazing. They made my experience easy and definitely calmed my nerves. What helped me most was the
positive guidance through out the entire procedure and explaining the entire process step by step as
the procedure was being done. It’s only been a month and I already have seen my veins disappear and
I feel great. [Read more][44]

I have nothing but good to say about Dr. Hamed Taheri and his caring, friendly, professional and
very knowledgeable staff in Long Beach CA. I was surprised at how little discomfort I felt during my
procedures, which I’m sure is due to Dr. Hamed Taheri’s expertise in this area and his results speak
for themselves. Thank you!
[Read more][45]

I found Dr. Hamed Taheri to be professional and informative. At my first appointment he walked me
step by step through the procedure he would do on my next appointment. He was very thoughtful and
kind. His staff was wonderful. When I showed up for the procedure everything was explained to me
again. I had both legs done on separate days and both went very well. I had very little pain of any
kind and the same was true for the days and weeks that followed. [Read more][46]

The Stealth 8 Neuronavigation System is a state-of-the-art technology that enhances the precision of

hard-to-reach areas. Advantages of using Sonastar include:

 
* **Precision Tumor Removal**: Ensures complete resection of tumors with minimal damage to

* **Enhanced Safety**: Reduces the risk of intraoperative complications.
* **Versatility**: Suitable for a variety of tumor types and locations.

our neurology hospital in Andhra Pradesh, we provide a multidisciplinary approach that ensures
optimal, evidence-based treatment with the support of specialty-trained nurses, technicians, and
rehabilitation therapists.

 

Dr. Rao’s Hospital in Neurosciences is the second facility in India to offer a flat-panel biplane
vascular hybrid cath lab and a full-storz endoscopic solution with 4K technology.

 

Our neurosurgery hospital in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, is the first hospital in South India to be
equipped with the Stealth 8 Neuronavigation System, intraoperative Xper dual CT, and intraoperative
neuromonitoring for accuracy and precision in neurosurgical treatment and is therefore considered
the best neurology, neurosurgery, and spine surgery hospital in Guntur.

 

## Neurosurgery at Dr. Rao’s Hospital: Excellence in Care and Affordable Medical Tourism

Dr. Rao’s Hospital, located in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, has established itself as a premier
destination for neurosurgery in India. The hospital is renowned for its state-of-the-art facilities,
cutting-edge technology, and highly skilled medical professionals led by the esteemed Dr. Mohana Rao
Patibandla. Dr. Rao’s Hospital combines advanced medical treatments with compassionate care, making
it a top choice for patients seeking neurosurgical procedures.

 

## Advanced Neurosurgical Equipment at Dr. Rao’s Hospital

Dr. Rao’s Hospital is equipped with the latest and most advanced neurosurgical equipment, ensuring
precise and effective treatments for a wide range of neurological conditions. Here’s an overview of
the key technologies available at the hospital and their advantages:

 

### Stealth 8 Neuronavigation System

The Stealth 8 Neuronavigation System is a state-of-the-art technology that enhances the precision of
neurosurgical procedures. This system provides real-time, 3D images of the brain, allowing surgeons
to navigate complex structures with unparalleled accuracy. The benefits include:

 
* **Enhanced Precision**: Reduces the risk of damage to critical brain structures.
* **Improved Outcomes**: Increases the success rate of surgeries.
* **Minimized Complications**: Reduces the likelihood of postoperative complications.
*  

### 4K Endoscopy for Spine, Brain, Ventricular, and Skull Base Surgeries

The 4K endoscopy system at Dr. Rao’s Hospital offers ultra-high-definition visualization during
minimally invasive surgeries. This technology is used for various procedures, including spine
surgery, brain surgery, ventricular operations, and skull base surgeries. The advantages include:

 
* **Superior Image Quality**: Provides clearer and more detailed images for better surgical
  outcomes.
* **Minimally Invasive**: Reduces trauma to surrounding tissues, leading to faster recovery times.
* **Versatility**: Suitable for a wide range of neurosurgical procedures.
*  

### Biplane Cath Lab for Cerebrovascular Interventions

The Biplane Cath Lab is designed for advanced cerebrovascular interventions, including stroke
treatment and aneurysm repair. This cutting-edge facility offers:

 
* **Enhanced Imaging**: Provides high-resolution, real-time imaging of blood vessels.
* **Precision**: Allows for accurate diagnosis and treatment of cerebrovascular conditions.
* **Improved Safety**: Minimizes radiation exposure and reduces procedure times.
*  

### Spine Suite for Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery

The Spine Suite at Dr. Rao’s Hospital is dedicated to minimally invasive spine surgery, utilizing
the latest techniques and technologies. Benefits include:

 
* **Reduced Recovery Time**: Patients experience quicker recovery and shorter hospital stays.
* **Less Pain**: Minimally invasive techniques result in less postoperative pain.
* **Lower Risk of Complications**: Minimizes the risk of infections and other complications.
*  

### Sonastar for Tumor Resection

The Sonastar system is a highly effective tool for tumor resection, particularly in delicate and
hard-to-reach areas. Advantages of using Sonastar include:

 
* **Precision Tumor Removal**: Ensures complete resection of tumors with minimal damage to
  surrounding tissues.
* **Enhanced Safety**: Reduces the risk of intraoperative complications.
* **Versatility**: Suitable for a variety of tumor types and locations.
*  

### BrainPath for Deep-Seated Brain Tumors

BrainPath technology is a revolutionary approach for accessing and treating deep-seated brain
tumors. Dr. Rao’s Hospital is one of the few facilities equipped with this advanced technology. The
benefits include:

 
* **Minimally Invasive Access**: Allows surgeons to reach deep-seated tumors with minimal disruption
  to brain tissue.
* **Improved Patient Outcomes**: Increases the likelihood of successful tumor removal and recovery.
* **Unique Availability**: Dr. Rao’s Hospital is one of the exclusive providers of BrainPath
  technology in the region.
*

compromising on quality. Here’s why medical tourism at Dr. Rao’s Hospital is an excellent choice:

 

#### Cost-Effective Treatment

One of the main advantages of seeking medical treatment at Dr. Rao’s Hospital is the affordability.
The cost of neurosurgical procedures in India is significantly lower than in many other countries,

Dr. Rao’s Hospital offers all-inclusive medical tourism packages that cover everything from initial

At Dr. Rao’s Hospital, patient care is personalized to meet the unique needs of each individual. The

#### State-of-the-Art Facilities

Dr. Rao’s Hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities that rival the best hospitals

#### Experienced and Skilled Medical Team

#### Streamlined Medical Tourism Process

Dr. Rao’s Hospital has a dedicated medical tourism team that assists international patients with all

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types

  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.

Developing and providing innovative interventional medical devices to patients to improve their

## Innovative interventional solutions addressing neurovascular and peripheral diseases

Headquartered in Singapore, the Hemo Group has built a suite of innovative interventional medical
devices targeting neuro-vascular diseases. Our comprehensive portfolio of neuro-interventional
medical devices covers the ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke and neuro access fields. We also
conduct advanced R&D in US, and have introduced our products internationally across Europe, Asia and
Middle East.

Other than being a top notch neuro medical device manufacturer with **CE MDR**, **EN ISO 13485**,
Certified Class 10K Cleanroom, we also provide the following services:
* OEM for medical devices
* [Regulatory and Market Access partnership strategic service for medical device companies desiring
  to venture into different markets][28]

Contact us at [enquire@hemocorp.com][29] for our services.

## Our Company's Devices

### Mechanical Thrombectomy Devices


Hemo's Mechanical Thrombectomy Devices offers neuro-interventionalists in a differentiated tool for
the treatment of acute ischemic stroke.

Our Mechanical Thrombectomy Devices consist of CE MDR approved AsprAX Aspiration Catheter and
CerebrAX Stent Retriever System.

Click [here][30] to find out more.

### Access Devices


Our Company's Access Devices provides access for other neuro interventional devices in the treatment
of acute ischemic stroke, intracranial atherosclerosis and hemorrhagic stroke .

Our Access Devices consist of Intermediate Catheter, Balloon Guiding Catheter, and Micro Catheter.

Click [here][31] to find out more.
[FocuStar-02]

### Dilation Devices


Our Company's Dilation Device offers neuro-interventionalists in a differentiated tool for the
treatment of intracranial stenosis.

Our Dilation Device Consist of Balloon Dilation Catheter and Neuro Dilation Catheter (OTW).

Click [here][32] to find out more.

## Resources

### [
### Interventional Treatment for Ischemic Stroke: A Game-Changer in Patient Outcomes
### ][33]


Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of disability and death worldwide, characterized by the sudden
loss of blood flow to a part of the brain due to a clot obstructing a blood vessel. Traditional
treatments have focused on clot-dissolving medications, but these are time-sensitive and not always
effective. Recent advancements in interventional treatment, particularly mechanical thrombectomy,
have revolutionized the management of ischemic stroke, offering new hope to patients who might
otherwise face severe disability or death.

Click [here][34] to find out more.

### [ Recognizing Stroke Symptoms and Immediate Actions to Take Introduction ][35]


Strokes are a leading cause of death and disability worldwide. As such, recognize stroke symptoms
early and acting quickly can save lives and significantly reduce the impact of a stroke. This
article aims to educate the public on how to identify stroke symptoms and the immediate actions that
should be taken.

Click [here][36] to find out more.

### [ Understanding the Differences Between Ischemic and Hemorrhagic Strokes ][37]


Strokes rank among the top causes of disability and death globally, highlighting the importance of
understanding stroke types and their impact on the brain. The two main types, ischemic stroke and
hemorrhagic stroke, differ in causes, symptoms, and treatment approaches. This article compares
ischemic and hemorrhagic strokes to help you recognize stroke symptoms and the need for immediate
medical intervention.

Click [here][38] to find out more.

#### ABOUT US

#### Interventional Radiology & Endovasculat Surgery

Interventional-Radiology.org and Endovascular.biz are educational platforms dedicated to sharing
real-world experience in interventional radiology and endovascular surgery. Through a carefully
curated collection of cases, we explore procedural techniques, technical decision-making,
problem-solving strategies, and clinical outcomes across a wide range of vascular and non-vascular
interventions.


The cases presented reflect individual approaches tailored to specific anatomical, pathological, and
clinical circumstances. They are intended as educational examples rather than prescriptive guidance,
recognising that multiple treatment strategies may be equally appropriate in contemporary practice.


While we showcase complex and challenging interventions, we also highlight routine cases that offer
valuable learning opportunities or particularly rewarding outcomes. Our goal is to support
continuous learning and professional development for clinicians at every stage of their career.

# Set Your Sights on Better Vision


[Set your Sights on Better Vision]

## Our goal is to help you see better

Laser Vision Correction

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,
Whitefield Road, Hoodi Village, Bengaluru) , **Women and Children Hospital Bangalore**

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,

# Welcome to Northeast Georgia Physicians Group

**Northeast Georgia Physicians Group (NGPG)** brings together over 700 talented physicians,
physician assistants, nurse practitioners, midwives and other clinical staff at more than 50
locations across North Georgia. As the state’s sixth-largest physician group, we always have a
practice nearby to offer you expert care in more than 40 specialties.

NGPG is affiliated with [Northeast Georgia Health System (NGHS)][60], a non-profit which serves more
than 1 million people in 19 counties across the region. As part of NGHS, patients of NGPG have a
direct connection to Northeast Georgia Medical Center’s seven hospitals in Gainesville, Braselton,
Winder, Dahlonega and Demorest.

TheNNT Rating System
**The Green Rating**
Therapies rated green are the best you can get
**The Yellow Rating**
Therapies rated yellow require more studies OR therapies with equal efficacy.
**The Red Rating**
Red suggest that benefits and harms may be equal or equivocal.
**The Black Rating**
Therapies rated black have very clear harms without any benefit.

Testosterone replacement therapy shows no clear benefit over placebo

04/23/2026

### [Sustained-Release Naltrexone for Opioid Dependence][47]

Sustained-release naltrexone reduces illicit opioid use compared to standard care but shows slightly
worse outcomes than opioid agonists
[Read More][48]

ACLS
[Read More][56]

TheNNT Rating System
**The Green Rating**
Therapies rated green are the best you can get
**The Yellow Rating**
Therapies rated yellow require more studies OR therapies with equal efficacy.
**The Red Rating**
Red suggest that benefits and harms may be equal or equivocal.
**The Black Rating**
Therapies rated black have very clear harms without any benefit.

## Highlighted Reviews

05/14/2026

### [Alpha-Lipoic Acid for Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy][43]

Alpha-lipoic acid shows little to no benefit over placebo for improving symptoms or impairment
[Read More][44]
04/30/2026

### [Testosterone Replacement in Men With Sexual Dysfunction in the Absence of Hypogonadism][45]

Testosterone replacement therapy shows no clear benefit over placebo
[Read More][46]
04/23/2026

### [Sustained-Release Naltrexone for Opioid Dependence][47]

Sustained-release naltrexone reduces illicit opioid use compared to standard care but shows slightly
worse outcomes than opioid agonists
[Read More][48]

## Recent Reviews

04/09/2026

### [Gonadotropins for Infertility in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome][49]

Gonadotropins increased live birth and clinical pregnancy rates
[Read More][50]
04/07/2026

### [Surgical vs. Nonsurgical Treatments for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome][51]

Surgery resulted in higher clinical improvement at long-term follow-up compared with splinting alone
[Read More][52]
03/31/2026

### [Higher Versus Lower Mean Arterial Blood Pressure Targets in Vasodilatory Shock][53]

Higher MAP targets are likely associated with increased 28-day all-cause mortality, less RRT-free
days, and increased risk of arrhythmia
[Read More][54]
02/17/2026

### [Extracorporeal Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation for Refractory Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest][55]

Extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation did not improve favorable neurological status at the
shortest follow-up and at 6 months or reduce in-hospital mortality when compared to conventional
ACLS
[Read More][56]
02/12/2026

### [Intravenous Thrombolysis for Minor Acute Ischemic Stroke][57]

Intravenous thrombolysis lowered functional independence and increased deaths at 90 days
[Read More][58]
01/29/2026

### [Noninvasive Respiratory Support for Pediatric Acute Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure][59]

Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) reduced risk of invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV)
compared to standard oxygen therapy (SOT), while both CPAP and high-flow nasal cannula (HFNC)
reduced treatment failure compared to SOT
[Read More][60]

research, data export, and priority support.

Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as
announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.
